events.title: AI Discovery Lab: Four AI Foundations for Business Transformation
events.description:
AI is changing the way businesses operate - but knowing where to start can be overwhelming. Join us for the AI Discovery Lab, an interactive morning designed specifically for Sunshine Coast businesses looking to confidently adopt AI and unlock new opportunities for growth.

Through four expert-led foundation sessions, you'll gain practical insights into AI for cyber intelligence, AI safety, privacy and governance, developing an AI-first roadmap and using AI to elevate your marketing. Each session is delivered by local AI specialists, with opportunities to ask questions, connect directly with the experts and network with other forward-thinking business leaders.

Whether you're just beginning your AI journey or looking to strengthen your existing approach, you'll leave with practical knowledge, actionable ideas and valuable local connections to help transform your business with confidence.

Proudly brought to you by Sunshine Coast Council, SCTechIA and Sunshine Coast Regional Jobs Committee as part of the Innovation @ Altitude Series.
events.location: Altitude Nine, South Sea Islander Way, Maroochydore QLD 4558
